item.title: Creative Commons launches Nutch-based Search
item.description: Creative Commons unveiled a beta version of its search engine, which scours the web for text, images, audio, and video free to re-use on certain terms a search refinement offered by no other company or organization. See the Creative Commons Press Release for more details.
